paragraphs.source_en: At the same time, I discovered the FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early) movement that the original *Your Money or Your Life* seems to have influenced greatly. Pete Adeney, a.k.a. Mr. Money Mustache, and other luminaries in a very large community of FIRE leaders and bloggers, welcomed me back into the fold warmly and I look forward to years of mischief making, myth busting, and world changing together.
